units.source_text: 常恐夜风将此花吹散也。”

en.t: I am always afraid that the night wind will blow this flower away."
The beauty of the handwriting goes without saying.

units.source_text: 只此小巧的包封，在这老年人看来也觉得香艳绮丽，令人目眩。

en.t: Even this small, delicate wrapper seemed gorgeously fragrant and dazzling to the old woman.

units.source_text: 老尼姑收到了这封信，甚是狼狈，不知如何答复才好。

en.t: When the old nun received this letter, she was deeply flustered and did not know how best to reply.

units.source_text: 终于写了回信：“前日偶尔谈及之事，我等视为一时戏言。

en.t: At last she wrote a reply: "The matter we happened to speak of the other day, we regarded as a passing jest.

units.source_text: 今蒙特地赐书，教人无可答复。

en.t: Now that you have graciously sent a letter on purpose, I find myself at a loss for any answer.

units.source_text: 外孙女年龄幼稚，连《难波津之歌》[\[20\]](#part1334.html#m20)也还写不端正，其实难于奉命。

en.t: My granddaughter is still very young, and cannot yet even write The Song of Naniwazu [20] properly, so in truth it is difficult to obey your request.
